outcome.Summary: Fixed the INI parser in ini/ini.go to match its documented format: lines are now trimmed before classification (so indented sections and '#'/' ;'-style comments work), section names are lower-cased, the first '=' (not last) splits key/value, quoted values keep inner whitespace exactly without re-trimming, inline comments only cut at " ;"/" #" in unquoted values, and repeated keys overwrite earlier ones. Verified with `go test ./... -count=1` (passes) plus a scratch program covering undocumented edge cases (indented comments, case-insensitive duplicate keys, '=' in values, ';' inside quotes); tests were left untouched.
